items.description: A color scheme on the Appearance screen. Colors are #rrggbb. Anything not given is worked out by static/js/theme.js at readable contrast.

button.description: How the theme's buttons look. A choice left out is the default (rounded, normal, raised, normal).

dark.description: A light theme's colors for dark mode, kept while it is light. Switching the theme to dark swaps them in. A light theme's light (or a dark theme's dark) is dropped.

tools.name: set_themes
tools.title: Replace your own themes

tools.description: Change anything about an item: name, photos, tags, quantity, low-stock level, expiry, custom fields, value, receipts, who it is lent to. Only what you send changes.

clear_remind_days.description: Use the household's reminder lead again.

fields.description: Custom field values by field id (see the household's fields). Replaces them all.

household_id.description: The household's id, from GET /api/households (list_households over MCP).

item_id.description: The item's id, from list_items, search_inventory or get_label.

lent_due.description: When it should come back, YYYY-MM-DD, or empty.

lent_to.description: Who has it on loan; empty when it is back.

low_stock.description: Remind when the quantity drops to this or below.

photos.description: File ids of its photos, in order.

quantity.description: How many there are. A new item has 1.

receipts.description: File ids of receipts or warranty papers.

remind_days.description: Days before the expiry to remind, instead of the household's lead.

tags.description: Words to find it by. Stored in lower case.

value.description: What one is worth, for the insurance list.

tools.name: update_item
tools.title: Change an item

tools.description: Change a container's name, color, type, location, outer container, photos, notes, moving state, handling flags or destination. Only what you send changes.

container_type.description: bin, box, drawer, shelf, bag, or anything else.

destination.description: For a move: the room it goes to.

flags.description: Handling notes printed on its label, such as fragile, this side up, heavy.

household_id.description: The household's id, from GET /api/households (list_households over MCP).

label_id.description: The container's id, from list_labels, search_inventory or scan_code.

move_status.description: For a move: packed, in_transit, unpacked, or empty.

parent_id.description: The container it sits inside; 0 for none.

photos.description: File ids of its photos, in order (see attach_photo).

tools.name: update_label
tools.title: Change a container

tools.description: Change a location's name, or move it inside another (0 for top-level). Only what you send changes.

household_id.description: The household's id, from GET /api/households (list_households over MCP).

parent_id.description: Move it inside another location; 0 makes it top-level.

tools.name: update_location
tools.title: Rename or move a location

tools.description: The account this API key belongs to, the role it acts with (role -- never higher than the key's own scope), and the account's own role.
